1317	    def _parse_verified_chain(
1318	        self, blocks_raw: object, endowment: int, genesis: Block | None = None
1319	    ) -> list[Block]:
1320	        """Strictly validate a block list submitted as (or persisted as) a fork.
1321	
1322	        The list must start from the canonical genesis block, connect through
1323	        consecutive heights and prev_hash values, and carry recomputed-correct
1324	        Merkle roots and block hashes. Transactions must have valid Ed25519
1325	        signatures, ascending and globally unique tx_ids, and a replay from the
1326	        per-identity endowment must never overspend. All blocks must be
1327	        confirmed except an optional pending tip. Raises ValueError on any
1328	        defect.
1329	        """
1330	        if not isinstance(blocks_raw, list) or not blocks_raw:
1331	            raise ValueError("'blocks' must be a non-empty list")
1332	        genesis = genesis if genesis is not None else self.chain[0]
1333	        blocks: list[Block] = []
1334	        seen_tx_ids: set[str] = set()
1335	        for i, block_raw in enumerate(blocks_raw):
1336	            if not isinstance(block_raw, dict):
1337	                raise ValueError(f"block at position {i} is not a JSON object")
1338	            try:
1339	                block = Block.from_dict(block_raw)
1340	            except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
1341	                raise ValueError(f"block {i} is malformed: {exc}") from exc
1342	            if isinstance(block.height, bool) or block.height != i:
1343	                raise ValueError(
1344	                    f"block at position {i} has non-consecutive height {block.height}"
1345	                )
1346	            expected_prev = GENESIS_PREV_HASH if i == 0 else blocks[i - 1].block_hash
1347	            if block.prev_hash != expected_prev:
1348	                raise ValueError(f"block {i} has a mismatched prev_hash")
1349	            if block.status not in (STATUS_PENDING, STATUS_CONFIRMED):
1350	                raise ValueError(f"block {i} has unknown status {block.status!r}")
1351	            if i == 0:
1352	                # The candidate must connect to *the* canonical genesis.
1353	                if (
1354	                    block.status != STATUS_CONFIRMED
1355	                    or block.transactions
1356	                    or block.block_hash != genesis.block_hash
1357	                    or block.merkle_root != genesis.merkle_root
1358	                ):
1359	                    raise ValueError("first block must be the canonical genesis block")
1360	            elif i < len(blocks_raw) - 1 and block.status == STATUS_PENDING:
1361	                raise ValueError(f"pending block {i} is not the chain tip")
1362	
1363	            txs_raw = block_raw.get("transactions")
1364	            if not isinstance(txs_raw, list):
1365	                raise ValueError(f"block {i} transactions must be a list")
1366	            tx_ids: list[str] = []
1367	            for j, tx in enumerate(block.transactions):
1368	                self._valid_tx_fields(tx)
1369	                if not crypto.verify_signature(tx.sender, tx.message, tx.signature):
1370	                    raise ValueError(f"block {i} transaction {j} has an invalid signature")
1371	                stored_id = txs_raw[j].get("tx_id") if isinstance(txs_raw[j], dict) else None
1372	                if stored_id != tx.tx_id:
1373	                    raise ValueError(
1374	                        f"block {i} transaction {j} has a mismatched tx_id"
1375	                    )
1376	                if tx.tx_id in seen_tx_ids:
1377	                    raise ValueError(f"duplicate transaction {tx.tx_id} in candidate")
1378	                seen_tx_ids.add(tx.tx_id)
1379	                tx_ids.append(tx.tx_id)
1380	            if tx_ids != sorted(tx_ids):
1381	                raise ValueError(f"block {i} transactions are not tx_id sorted")
1382	            if crypto.merkle_root(tx_ids) != block.merkle_root:
1383	                raise ValueError(f"block {i} Merkle root mismatch")
1384	            if (
1385	                compute_block_hash(block.height, block.prev_hash, block.merkle_root)
1386	                != block.block_hash
1387	            ):
1388	                raise ValueError(f"block {i} block_hash mismatch")
1389	            blocks.append(block)
1390	
1391	        # Replay every transaction from the per-identity endowment; unconfirmed
1392	        # (pending tip) transactions are included so a candidate can never hide
1393	        # an overspend behind a pending final block.
1394	        balances: dict[str, int] = {}
1395	        for block in blocks:
1396	            for tx in block.transactions:
1397	                sender_balance = balances.get(tx.sender, endowment)
1398	                if sender_balance < tx.amount:
1399	                    raise ValueError(
1400	                        f"replay overspend by {tx.sender} in block {block.height}"
1401	                    )
1402	                balances[tx.sender] = sender_balance - tx.amount
1403	                balances[tx.recipient] = balances.get(tx.recipient, endowment) + tx.amount
1404	        return blocks

1406	    def validate_fork_blocks(self, blocks_raw: object) -> list[Block]:
1407	        """Validate and parse a candidate fork submitted by a client.
1408	
1409	        The blocks must start from the canonical genesis block, connect via
1410	        consecutive heights and prev_hash, carry correct block hashes and
1411	        Merkle roots, unique ascending tx_ids with valid Ed25519 signatures and
1412	        no replay overspend, and be all confirmed except an optional pending
1413	        tip. Raises ValueError with a descriptive reason on any defect.
1414	        """
1415	        endowment = (
1416	            self.initial_balance if self.initial_balance is not None else 1_000_000
1417	        )
1418	        return self._parse_verified_chain(blocks_raw, endowment)

1420	    def _parse_persisted_forks(
1421	        self,
1422	        forks_raw: object,
1423	        canonical_chain: list[Block],
1424	        endowment: int | None = None,
1425	    ) -> dict[str, list[Block]]:
1426	        """Parse persisted candidate forks, dropping invalid ones on restart.
1427	
1428	        Every stored fork is re-validated exactly like a fresh submission
1429	        (genesis connection, hashes, Merkle roots, signatures, uniqueness,
1430	        replay). A fork that no longer validates is silently discarded rather
1431	        than failing recovery of the canonical chain. Recovery of the canonical
1432	        chain itself remains strict and still raises StateRecoveryError. The
1433	        replay uses ``endowment`` — the value recorded in this snapshot — rather
1434	        than the startup argument, so a different launch parameter cannot make
1435	        a persisted fork legal or illegal.
1436	        """
1437	        if not isinstance(forks_raw, list):
1438	            return {}
1439	        if endowment is None:
1440	            endowment = DEFAULT_INITIAL_BALANCE
1441	        genesis = canonical_chain[0]
1442	        forks: dict[str, list[Block]] = {}
1443	        for entry in forks_raw:
1444	            try:
1445	                fork = self._parse_verified_chain(entry, endowment, genesis)
1446	            except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
1447	                continue
1448	            if not fork or fork[0].block_hash != genesis.block_hash:
1449	                continue
1450	            tip_hash = fork[-1].block_hash
1451	            # The canonical chain (or a strict prefix of it, matched by any
1452	            # canonical block hash) is never also stored as a candidate.
1453	            if any(tip_hash == block.block_hash for block in canonical_chain):
1454	                continue
1455	            forks.setdefault(tip_hash, fork)
1456	        return forks

1458	    def replace_chain(self, new_chain: list[Block]) -> None:
1459	        """Atomically adopt a fork: swap the canonical chain, reconcile the
1460	        mempool (old-chain-only confirmed transactions return de-duplicated;
1461	        pending-block transactions never enter the pool) and rebuild indexes.
1462	        Does not save; the caller persists.
1463	        """
1464	        old_confirmed_ids = {
1465	            tx.tx_id
1466	            for block in self.chain
1467	            if block.status == STATUS_CONFIRMED
1468	            for tx in block.transactions
1469	        }
1470	        new_ids = {tx.tx_id for block in new_chain for tx in block.transactions}
1471	        old_tx_by_id = {
1472	            tx.tx_id: tx
1473	            for block in self.chain
1474	            for tx in block.transactions
1475	        }
1476	        # Transactions unique to the superseded chain's confirmed history go
1477	        # back to the mempool, de-duplicated against anything already queued.
1478	        # Transactions from the old pending tip are not in old_confirmed_ids,
1479	        # so they are dropped, never re-enqueued.
1480	        for tx_id in old_confirmed_ids - new_ids:
1481	            self.pending.setdefault(tx_id, old_tx_by_id[tx_id])
1482	        # Transactions now on the adopted chain must leave the mempool.
1483	        for tx_id in new_ids:
1484	            self.pending.pop(tx_id, None)
1485	        self.chain = new_chain
1486	        self.rebuild_derived()

1500	        }
